headlines.description: — Tyler Tejada and Myles Colvin scored 23 points apiece, and Cincinnati blew a 17-point lead before the Bearcats held off previously undefeated Georgia 83-81 on Thursday at the ESPN Events Invitational -- Magic Group for their fourth consecutive win.
